sources.title: KANNAGI — route order and unlock conditions

sources.title: KANNAGI — complete dead-end paths, including delayed 15
sources.notes: Directly inspected all 21 endings, the complete delayed No.15 chain and both No.14 entrances. Do not concatenate alternative paths. Component of the original 2021 remake walkthrough set.

sources.title: XNEO — independent Japanese routes and dead ends
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent full heroine paths and dead-end choices. Supplies the default second evidence lane. Different optional choices and transcriptions are retained as evidence, not assumed to be target-exact.

sources.title: Asobigokoro — Arcueid save checkpoints
sources.notes: Directly inspected numbered checkpoints and endings. Local saves 1–10 map to global 2–11. Original remake routing corroboration; later page update dates are not used as evidence for another edition.

sources.title: Asobigokoro — Ciel save checkpoints and additional choices
sources.notes: Directly inspected local saves 3–13 (global 12–22), Normal-to-True reload and supplementary choices. Includes a distinct No.15 chain not mixed into KANNAGI's selected chain. Exact-release text verification remains open.

sources.title: Official 2021 menu still — Day 3 reality choice
sources.notes: Actual public image pixels directly inspected, option 2 in lower portion: ……いや、俺の起こした現実だ。 Supports existing Ciel Normal step 13 simpleJp over KANNAGI's が transcription, without changing jpGuide1/jpGuide2. Still image, no video timecode. Original official console-product evidence; no visible Switch/PS4, build or download-edition identifier. Reviewer acceptance for r82483 remains outstanding; no claim about the other 13 disputed strings.

sources.title: TYPE-MOON — original console product context
sources.notes: Directly inspected official product table identifies 発売日 2021年8月26日 and 対象機種 PlayStation®4／Nintendo Switch™, with download editions. Establishes the original two-platform product context of the official 2021 tip, not the hardware used for its screenshot. No PS4-to-Switch or 2021-to-2024 equivalence is inferred from publication date alone.
